instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete Italian Electronic Invoicing system (Fatturazione Elettronica / FatturaPA SDI) in Italian language with full end-to-end functionality.
Authentication: Google Login simulation with multi-tenant company support and Admin approval workflow for new company users. Non-approved users see a clear 'In attesa di approvazione admin' screen.

Dashboard Page: KPI metrics (Totale Fatturato, Imponibile Totale, IVA Totale, Fatture da Incassare, Conteggio SDI per Stato - Bozza, Inviata, Consegnata, Scartata), Charts for monthly billing trends, recent invoice feed with status badges.

Anagrafica Clienti & Fornitori (CRUD): Full management of Customer/Supplier data with P.IVA validation (11 digits), Codice Fiscale, Codice Destinatario SDI (7 characters or '0000000'), PEC, Indirizzo completo (Via, Cap, Comune, Provincia, Nazione).
Impostazioni Cedente/Prestatore: Company settings page to manage own company details (Ragione Sociale, P.IVA, Codice Fiscale, Regime Fiscale e.g. RF01, Indirizzo, IBAN per pagamenti, Logo aziendale).

Creazione & Modifica Fattura: Full invoice builder with dynamic line items (Descrizione, Quantità, Prezzo Unitario, Aliquota IVA 22%, 10%, 5%, 4%, 0% Esente), auto calculation of Imponibile, Totale IVA, and Totale Fattura. Selection of Cliente from Anagrafica auto-fills SDI Code, PEC, and Address.

Generazione XML FatturaPA: Generate strict FatturaPA 1.2.1 compliant XML structure downloadable with proper filename (e.g. IT01234567890_F0001.xml). Includes XML preview modal with syntax highlighting.
Stampa PDF: Printable invoice view formatted according to standard Italian commercial layout with header, cedente/prestatore, cessionario/committente, line table, IVA summary, and payment details.

Invio SDI (Simulation Engine): Ability to simulate sending invoice to Sistema di Interscambio (SDI) with intermediate statuses (Bozza -> Inviata -> Consegnata / Scartata with detailed error reason on rejection). Includes status update notifications via Sonner toast.
Gestione Utenti (Admin): Admin panel allowing approved admins to view pending registrations, approve or reject users, and assign roles (Admin, Contabile, Operatore).

Ensure every interactive element (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, status pills, table action buttons) includes explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='create-invoice-btn', data-testid='sdi-status-pill', data-testid='download-xml-btn').
Use Lucide-react icons for navigation and actions. Maintain high contrast, clean spacing, and zero transparent background cutoffs in dropdowns or modals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic AI template styles or dark gradients over text.
Always set explicit hover and focus text/bg states for interactive controls.
Maintain high spacing consistency with Tailwind scale (p-4, p-6, p-8).
Dropdowns, select menus, and dialog overlays MUST have solid/opaque background (e.g. bg-white dark:bg-slate-900) - NEVER transparent.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are kebab-case and role-descriptive.
UI language must strictly be standard Italian professional business terminology (Fattura, Cliente, Fornitore, P.IVA, Codice Destinatario, Imponibile, Aliquota IVA, Stato SDI).
